points.title: 早年成长
points.description: 马可·波罗出生于威尼斯的一个商人家庭。他的父亲尼科洛·波罗和叔叔马费奥·波罗都是威尼斯著名的商人，经常前往东方进行贸易。马可·波罗在威尼斯度过了他的童年和青少年时期，接受了良好的教育，学习了商业知识、多种语言以及当时流行的地理知识。这段时期为他日后东行奠定了基础，培养了他对商业和冒险的兴趣。
points.descriptionEn: Marco Polo was born in Venice to a family of merchants. His father Niccolò and uncle Maffeo were prominent Venetian traders who frequently traveled to the East. Marco spent his childhood and adolescence in Venice, receiving a good education in commercial knowledge, multiple languages, and contemporary geography. This period laid the foundation for his later eastern journey and fostered his interest in commerce and adventure.

points.title: 东行之旅
points.description: 1271年，17岁的马可·波罗随父亲和叔叔开始了前往东方的旅程。他们沿着丝绸之路穿越波斯、中亚，经过帕米尔高原，最终抵达元朝。这段历时四年的艰苦旅程中，马可·波罗不仅学习了沿途各国的语言和文化，还详细记录了各地的风土人情、商业贸易和地理特征。这段经历极大地开阔了他的视野，为他日后撰写《马可·波罗游记》积累了丰富的第一手资料。
points.descriptionEn: In 1271, at the age of 17, Marco Polo embarked on his journey to the East with his father and uncle. They traveled along the Silk Road through Persia, Central Asia, across the Pamir Plateau, and finally reached the Yuan Dynasty. During this four-year arduous journey, Marco not only learned the languages and cultures of various regions but also documented local customs, commercial activities, and geographical features. This experience greatly broadened his horizons and provided rich firsthand material for his later work, 'The Travels of Marco Polo'.

points.title: 元朝仕途
points.description: 1275年，马可·波罗抵达元大都（今北京），受到元世祖忽必烈的接见和赏识。他留在元朝宫廷服务长达17年，担任过多种职务，包括忽必烈的特使和地方官员。马可·波罗曾奉命前往云南、缅甸、印度等地执行外交任务，还曾参与管理扬州等城市。这段经历使他深入了解了中国的政治、经济和文化，特别是元朝的行政体系、货币制度和城市繁荣景象。他还向忽必烈介绍了欧洲的情况，促进了东西方文化交流。
points.descriptionEn: In 1275, Marco Polo arrived at Khanbaliq (modern-day Beijing) and was received and favored by Kublai Khan, the founder of the Yuan Dynasty. He served in the Yuan court for 17 years in various capacities, including special envoy and local official. Marco Polo was sent on diplomatic missions to Yunnan, Burma, India, and other places, and also participated in administering cities like Yangzhou. This experience allowed him to gain deep insights into Chinese politics, economy, and culture, particularly the administrative system, monetary system, and urban prosperity of the Yuan Dynasty. He also introduced European conditions to Kublai Khan, promoting cultural exchange between East and West.

points.title: 归国历程
points.description: 1291年，马可·波罗随蒙古公主从泉州出发，经海路返回欧洲。他们航行经过东南亚、印度洋、波斯湾，最终抵达君士坦丁堡。这次海上航行历时约四年，马可·波罗继续记录沿途的地理、商业和文化信息。1295年，马可·波罗终于回到威尼斯，此时他已经离开家乡24年。带回了大量东方珍宝和财富，以及丰富的见闻记录。这次归程不仅使他积累了更多地理知识，也为他日后撰写游记提供了更多素材。
points.descriptionEn: In 1291, Marco Polo departed from Quanzhou with a Mongol princess, returning to Europe by sea. They sailed through Southeast Asia, the Indian Ocean, the Persian Gulf, and finally reached Constantinople. This sea journey took about four years, during which Marco continued to document geographical, commercial, and cultural information. In 1295, Marco Polo finally returned to Venice, having been away from home for 24 years. He brought back numerous Eastern treasures and wealth, along with rich records of his experiences. This return journey not only added to his geographical knowledge but also provided more material for his later writings.

points.title: 晚年著述
points.description: 1298年，马可·波罗在威尼斯与热那亚的战争中被俘，在狱中开始口述他的东方见闻，由狱友鲁斯蒂恰诺记录整理，形成了《马可·波罗游记》的初稿。出狱后，他继续修改完善这部著作。马可·波罗晚年继续参与威尼斯的商业活动，但主要精力放在完善他的游记上。这部著作详细描述了他在东方的所见所闻，包括中国的城市、风俗、政治制度等，对欧洲人了解东方产生了深远影响。1324年，马可·波罗在威尼斯逝世，享年约70岁。他的《马可·波罗游记》成为中世纪欧洲最重要的地理著作之一，对后来的地理大发现产生了重要影响。
points.descriptionEn: In 1298, Marco Polo was captured during the war between Venice and Genoa. In prison, he began dictating his Eastern experiences to fellow prisoner Rustichello da Pisa, who recorded and organized them into the first draft of 'The Travels of Marco Polo'. After his release, he continued to revise and perfect this work. In his later years, Marco Polo continued to engage in commercial activities in Venice but focused mainly on refining his travelogue. This work detailed his observations in the East, including Chinese cities, customs, and political systems, profoundly influencing Europeans' understanding of the East. Marco Polo died in Venice in 1324 at approximately 70 years old. His 'The Travels of Marco Polo' became one of the most important geographical works in medieval Europe and had a significant impact on later geographical discoveries.

supporter.zh: 马可·波罗被誉为东西方文化交流的先驱，他的《马可·波罗游记》为欧洲人打开了了解东方世界的窗口。他不仅是一位勇敢的旅行家，更是一位敏锐的观察者和记录者。他的著作详细描述了13世纪中国的繁荣景象，包括城市规模、行政制度、商业活动等，纠正了当时欧洲对东方的许多误解。马可·波罗的探险精神和跨文化交流的勇气，激励了后来的航海家和探险家，包括哥伦布，对地理大发现产生了深远影响。
supporter.en: Marco Polo is hailed as a pioneer of East-West cultural exchange. His 'The Travels of Marco Polo' opened a window for Europeans to understand the Eastern world. He was not only a brave traveler but also a keen observer and recorder. His work detailed the prosperity of 13th-century China, including city sizes, administrative systems, and commercial activities, correcting many European misconceptions about the East. Marco Polo's spirit of adventure and courage in cross-cultural exchange inspired later navigators and explorers, including Columbus, profoundly influencing the Age of Discovery.

critic.zh: 批评者指出马可·波罗的游记存在夸大和失实之处，如他声称曾担任高级官员、参与重大决策等，缺乏确凿证据。一些学者认为他对中国的描述过于理想化，忽视了当时的社会矛盾和问题。此外，游记中对东方财富的过度渲染，可能助长了欧洲对东方的贪婪和掠夺心态。批评者还质疑马可·波罗是否真的到过中国，认为他的描述可能基于他人的传闻或想象，而非亲身经历。这些争议使他的历史地位和贡献受到一定质疑。
critic.en: Critics point out that Marco Polo's travelogue contains exaggerations and inaccuracies, such as his claims of holding high official positions and participating in major decisions, which lack concrete evidence. Some scholars argue that his descriptions of China are overly idealized, ignoring the social contradictions and problems of the time. Additionally, his excessive emphasis on Eastern wealth may have contributed to European greed and predatory attitudes toward the East. Critics also question whether Marco Polo actually visited China, suggesting that his descriptions might be based on others' accounts or imagination rather than personal experience. These controversies have somewhat questioned his historical status and contributions.

objective.zh: 从历史学和流行文化视角看，马可·波罗已成为东西方交流的象征性人物。尽管他的游记存在争议，但其历史价值不容忽视。它为欧洲提供了关于东方的第一手资料，促进了地理学、民族学和商业知识的发展。在流行文化中，马可·波罗被塑造成冒险精神和探索未知的象征，影响着后世对东方的认知。现代研究表明，他的描述虽有夸张，但基本事实框架是可靠的，特别是关于中国城市规模、经济繁荣和行政体系的描述，对研究13世纪欧亚交流具有重要价值。
objective.en: From historical and cultural perspectives, Marco Polo has become a symbolic figure of East-West exchange. Despite controversies in his travelogue, its historical value cannot be ignored. It provided Europeans with firsthand information about the East, promoting the development of geography, ethnology, and commercial knowledge. In popular culture, Marco Polo is portrayed as a symbol of adventurous spirit and exploring the unknown, influencing later perceptions of the East. Modern research indicates that while his descriptions contain exaggerations, the basic factual framework is reliable, especially his accounts of Chinese urban scale, economic prosperity, and administrative systems, which are valuable for studying 13th-century Eurasian exchange.

self.zh: 我还没有讲述我所见之事的一半。
self.en: I have not told half of what I saw.

others.zh: 马可·波罗是第一位向西方系统介绍中国的旅行家，他的游记是中世纪欧洲最重要的地理著作之一。
others.en: Marco Polo was the first traveler to systematically introduce China to the West, and his travelogue is one of the most important geographical works in medieval Europe.
